remarks:
This recreational land with building site sits on 7 acres with fruit trees and beautiful views located in South Dayton NY, Chautauqua County.

The land is mostly level with a mixture of open land, shrubs and is loaded with apple trees.  It is wooded right off the road for privacy and opens up in the middle of the property and then wooded again in the back. Perfect location to park your camper, or build your cabin or home with ultimate privacy.  Electric is located at the road and has 324 feet of road frontage.  Wildlife sign throughout, and there is a trail system to easily access the property.  A natural spring runs through the back portion of the property which would be a perfect opportunity to build a pond.  Additional acreage is available upon request.  All rights convey.

This property is located approximately 12 minutes to Forestville, 20 minutes to Gowanda, 25 minutes to Dunkirk, 40 minutes to Springville, 50 minutes to Buffalo, and 1 hour 10 minutes to Erie.
